answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 66556 Country: india Title: Ruling about talaqs Question: I have got married one year before everything was going right but suddenly me and my wife start fights together. One day we were miffing together and the thing gone such that I have got angry a lot. I decided to affright her. I know one thing about talaq that if I say three times talaq then it will happen but by saying 2 or 1 time it will not happen if the husband and wife get agree. But I was unknown that by saying I give you talaq or I am giving you talaq when you just want to affright her talaq will happen. I tried to affright her and I said that (By doing acting same as T.V. serial I was totally unknown that by saying I give you talaq it will happen. I only want to affright her I do not want to give talaq to her. I was just acting like a T.V. serial.) I give you talaq. She did not get agree. I replied I am giving you talaq. But she did not get agree. So I said her two times talaq-talaq not three times. Because I know only that after some time we will get agree. Then my talaq will held? If yes then will say it will all happen by mistake or by fault when namaz and Ramadan also allow fault by mistake then why not in talaq. Me and my wife do not want left each other. We do not want to do halalah because we have personal problems. Answer ID: 66556 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 774/142/tatima/D=09/1437) If you said like this, “I am giving you talaq” “I give you talaq” and talaq-talaq then three talaq mughallaza occurred. The nikah of both of you came to an end completely. The woman after completing her iddah shall be free and can marry anyone except you. Now you cannot marry her without a Shariah halalah. Talaq takes place whether it is given seriously or jokingly. Three talaqstook place whether you knew that talaq occurs or you said it to threaten her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
